subs.note: Pierre Clereau. The movements of the mass, each on its own.

items.title: Kyrie (Clereau, Missa Virginis Mariae)
items.desc: Pierre Clereau, Missa Virginis Mariae, Kyrie, 1557. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
